_doc: Capability catalog injected at SessionStart by inject.py as additionalContext. Goal: auto-tool-selection — keep the right MCP/skill in front of the model so it reaches for a real tool instead of a makeshift script. DATA-driven: edit `groups` to maintain. Keep terse + high-signal; the WHEN clause is the load-bearing part. Mirrors but is broader than skill-router/capabilities.py (which only fires on prompt keyword match).
header: [capabilities] Auto-pick the right tool (don't hand-roll a script when a registered MCP/skill exists). Reach for these WHEN the trigger matches — many are under-used:
footer: If a backend MCP isn't connected (cve/searxng/perplexity/sonar/codacy/ghidra/ida/frida), name the daemon to start rather than saying 'no access'. Full routing: guides/tool-routing-and-quality.md.

items: basic-memory (build_context/search_notes/recent_activity) — WHEN resuming, after compaction, or user cites prior work: RECALL before asking. write_note WHEN you learn a durable decision/fact/preference.
serena (find_symbol / find_referencing_symbols / get_symbols_overview / replace_symbol_body) — WHEN navigating/editing code by SYMBOL across a repo: prefer over grep/manual walks (true LSP).
repomix (pack_codebase / grep_repomix_output) — WHEN you need whole-repo context or a code review over many files.
context7 (resolve-library-id / query-docs) — WHEN using any library/framework/SDK/API: fetch CURRENT docs (training data may be stale).
ida-pro-mcp / ghidra-mcp / binary-ninja-mcp — WHEN disassembling/decompiling, xrefs, offsets, prototypes on a native binary (use the one whose DB is loaded).
radare2 (skill) — WHEN a fast headless triage of a binary; frida-mcp — WHEN hooking/instrumenting a LIVE process at runtime; cheatengine — WHEN scanning/pointer-chaining live process memory.
apktool-mcp / jadx-mcp — WHEN decoding/repacking an APK or reading Java/smali.
tooluniverse (find_tools then execute_tool) — 2500+ pharmacology/biomed tools: WHEN drug-target/DDI/ADMET/CYP/FDA-label/gene-disease questions — call find_tools FIRST to discover the exact tool.
scholarly-access / paper-search — WHEN papers/DOIs/citations/OA-PDFs; firecrawl/tavily/exa — WHEN deep web research or scrape/crawl (don't hand-roll requests+BeautifulSoup).
rdkit — WHEN cheminformatics (SMILES/descriptors/fingerprints/similarity), license-free; schrodinger — WHEN docking/Glide/FEP/MMGBSA/ADMET/structure-prep (Maestro license).

qdx-rush (exess_interaction_energy / exess_energy / exess_optimization / nnxtb_energy / boltz_fold / fried_fragmented_exess / prepare_protein_ligand / run_collect) — WHEN QM-accurate quantum chemistry on the QDX/Rush cloud beats MM/docking: EXESS RI-MP2/DFT single-point + INTERACTION energies (negative=binding), geometry-opt, QM/MM, fast NN-xTB screens, Boltz co-fold+affinity. Async: submit -> run_status -> run_collect; auth ~/.rush/.env; reference D:/Research/_infra/qdx_mcp/QDX_REFERENCE.md + skill qdx-rush. NOTE: QDX/EXESS/rush-py are NOT in training data — they exist locally; reach for this MCP, do NOT claim 'no QM tool available'.
chrome-devtools (performance_start_trace / lighthouse_audit / list_network_requests / list_console_messages) — WHEN web perf, Lighthouse, network/console debugging.
playwright / claude-in-chrome — WHEN driving a real browser (forms, screenshots, e2e).

secsearch (skill) — WHEN searching exploits/advisories/security corpora; lolbin-lookup (skill) — WHEN a Windows living-off-the-land binary's abuse technique; cve-mcp — WHEN CVE detail/lookup (start backend if absent).
searxng — WHEN a self-hosted meta web search; perplexity — WHEN a cited deep-answer; semgrep/bandit/trivy/gitleaks — WHEN SAST/secret/dep scanning before finishing code.
excel (read/write/pivot) over pandas+openpyxl; pdf-reader / ocr-suite over pdfplumber; markitdown for doc->md.
docker / github_cli (gh) / codecov / sonarqube / codacy — WHEN containers, PRs/issues/releases, coverage, or quality gates.
